verdict.rationale: TeamViewer documents an AI troubleshooting assistant that users query in natural language for device-specific answers, plus an AI agent (Tia) and voice commands for hands-free smart-glasses operation. However, the natural-language interface is shown only for getting answers and insights, not for issuing commands that operate the product, and the voice commands are not described as free-form natural language. Missing for 10: evidence that natural-language commands actually perform product actions (start sessions, run scripts, manage devices), documentation of the command scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: By querying our AI troubleshooting assistant, find faults and fix them fast, using natural language to get real-time, device-specific answers and insights.
Tia, your AI agent, learns from every support session to predict, prevent, and rapidly fix IT issues.
Hands-free operation: Voice commands and sensors replace paper instructions.
